field_definitions.ai_enabled: KNOWN_TRUE asserts that the target includes or uses AI capabilities, so AI-specific controls apply to it.
field_definitions.contains_customer_data: KNOWN_TRUE asserts that the target holds or processes customer data.
field_definitions.internet_exposed: KNOWN_TRUE asserts that the target, or a service it provides, is reachable from the public internet.
field_definitions.production: KNOWN_TRUE asserts that the target is used as, or supports, a production system, so production-data, recovery and release controls are in play.

not_applicable_semantics.fields_not_usable_in_rules_statement: owner, tier, service_criticality and data_classification are declared classification fields that are not usable in rules in this version.
statements: A not_applicable_rule is a flat list of conditions and all conditions must match.
When every field named by a published rule is known and every condition is met, the result is NOT_APPLICABLE.
When every field named by a published rule is known and not every condition is met, the result is APPLICABLE.
NO_RULE_WILL_BE_PUBLISHED resolves to APPLICABLE for every target whatever the facts.
When any field named by a published rule is UNKNOWN the result is APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED, even when another named field already fails its condition.
The not_applicable_decision_state governs the resolved result; default_applicability_result describes the result absent a decision.
